# jamfplatform_pro_mobile_device_extension_attribute (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro mobile device extension attribute by ID or by exact name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be supplied.

**Required Jamf privileges**

The Jamf Platform API integration used by the provider must be granted the following privileges:

| Jamf Pro privilege | Scoped name |
|---|---|
| Read Mobile Device Extension Attributes | `extension-attributes:read` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jamfplatform_pro_mobile_device_extension_attribute" "by_id" {
  id = "1"
}

data "jamfplatform_pro_mobile_device_extension_attribute" "by_name" {
  name = "Device Role"
}

output "mobile_ea_input_type" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_mobile_device_extension_attribute.by_name.input_type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Mobile device extension attribute ID. Mutually exclusive with `name`.
- `name` (String) Mobile device extension attribute display name (exact match). Mutually exclusive with `id`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `allow_multiple_values` (Boolean) Whether multiple values are collected for a directory-service-mapped attribute.
- `data_type` (String) Data type collected (`STRING`, `INTEGER`, `DATE`).
- `description` (String) Description of the extension attribute.
- `directory_service_attribute` (String) Mapped directory-service attribute name.
- `input_type` (String) Input type (`TEXT`, `POPUP`, `DIRECTORY_SERVICE_ATTRIBUTE_MAPPING`).
- `inventory_display` (String) Inventory display category.
- `popup_menu_choices` (Set of String) Pop-up menu choices (POPUP input type). Returned sorted alphabetically.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
